cohort: Pregnant women in their third trimester attending an antenatal clinic
finding: Women who delivered vaginally had a more distensible puborectalis muscle than those who delivered by emergency cesarean section, regardless of their previous delivery history.
mod_finding: Women who underwent a successful vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC) had less distensible pelvic floor muscles compared to their nulliparous and primiparous counterparts who delivered vaginally in the past.
